datasheet_identity.title: US1A THRU US1M SURFACE MOUNT HIGH EFFICIENT RECTIFIER

extraction_notes: The datasheet contains usable typical electrical curves on p. 2: the US1G forward trace in Fig. 3 and the Tj = 25 degC and Tj = 125 degC reverse traces in Fig. 4.
Forward-curve points were digitized from the dashed US1G trace only; no intermediate points were synthesized.
Reverse-curve points were digitized from the plotted traces only. The reverse-current axis is labeled in microamperes; extracted values are represented in amperes.
VRRM, VRMS, and VDC ratings for US1G are 400 V on p. 1. These are maximum blocking ratings, not an explicitly specified reverse breakdown voltage, so breakdown_voltage and breakdown_current are null.
The separate TA = 100 degC reverse-current table row, 500 microA, was not used for the 25 degC reverse-current specification.
